column1: # Clean display titles for the arcade launcher.
# Format: <romname><TAB><Display title>   -- the ROM name is the filename
# without its extension, and the separator must be a real tab. Lines starting
# with # are ignored. Entries here always beat the generated cache, so this is
# where you trim the region/revision noise the libretro database carries
# Anything not listed here falls back to the cache
# databases), and then to the bare filename.
